title: Same Error, Every Time — Until It Named the Cause | vitalii.no
description:
Every time our Telegram bot failed, it showed the same generic message: 'Помилка обробки' — 'processing error' — no matter what had actually broken. That is exactly how a revoked API key sat unnoticed for four months, from April to August. The bot just looked like it was having a bad day, over and over, with nothing in the message pointing at the real cause.

I added a classifier that reads the raw error text and matches it against known failure shapes before the generic fallback ever fires. A quota error now says the daily limit is exhausted. An invalid or revoked key gets its own message instead of blending into 'processing error'. A retired model is named directly, by its configured name, instead of failing silently. Every call site now also logs each attempt into a day-keyed usage tally, so the bot can answer a direct question about how close it is to its free usage ceiling instead of guessing.

Quota, dead key, retired model — three failures that used to look completely identical now each name themselves on the very first failed message, not the first support conversation.
